entries.title: Customer messages beyond orders in one list
entries.need: Only order events could send SMS or email; refunds, invoices, tickets, warranty and account messages had no settings.
entries.now: Notifications lists every event by group with SMS, WhatsApp, email, customer and shop switches and editable text; tickets, invoice reminders and service requests send.
try: Open Settings › Notifications and scroll to Customers and account
Turn on Ticket opened and edit its text
Make a new support ticket with a phone number and see the message in the delivery log
On a customer's Invoices, open an unpaid invoice and send a reminder
entries.left: Invoice sent and Sign-in code show Not sent yet: nothing sends an invoice on its own and sign-in codes need the server; loyalty messages stay in Loyalty.

entries.title: Create order and New ticket on the profile
entries.need: Staff on a customer's page could not start an order or a support ticket for that customer.
entries.now: The profile's More menu and Overview have Create order and New ticket; the ticket form opens with the name and phone filled in.
try: Open a customer
Tap More › New ticket and check the name and phone
Make the ticket and see it on the customer's Overview
Tap Create order: the order form opens with the customer picked

entries.title: Full picture for every customer
entries.need: Only the demo customer showed tickets, coupons and messages, and those were made up.
entries.now: Every customer shows their real tickets, store credit, loyalty progress, offers used, messages sent, next meeting and an Insights card.
try: Open a customer who has a support ticket
See Support tickets and Insights on Overview
Open Orders for store credit and offers used
Open Messages & activity for messages sent

entries.title: One Automations page with tabs
entries.need: Automatic work was spread over seven pages and menus.
entries.now: Automations has tabs for each rule area, AI rules, notifications, cart reminders, smart offers and auto-call; the other pages sit under it.
try: Open Communications › Automations
Tap AI to see Grid AI's rules
Tap Reminders and open the reminder settings
Check the menu lights Automations there
entries.left: Grid AI › Automations keeps its own row in Grid AI so the Retail edition still reaches it; the AI tab here shows the same rules.

entries.title: Marketing menu down to five rows
entries.need: The Marketing menu had thirteen rows, with offers and loyalty split over many pages.
entries.now: Marketing shows Offers, Loyalty, Abandoned carts, Ad audiences and Google Business; coupons, flash sales, smart offers and loyalty pages are tabs.
try: Open Marketing › Offers and tap Coupons
Open Marketing › Loyalty and tap Members
Sign in as a shop seller and check Members is still in the menu

entries.title: GridAI button no longer covers rows
entries.need: On a computer the floating GridAI button hid a row's buttons and part of cards.
entries.now: The button is a small round icon that shows its name on hover, and every page keeps room at its end.
entries.where: Every page with the GridAI button (e.g. Marketing › Offers)
try: Open Marketing › Offers on a computer
Scroll to the end and check the last row is clear
Hover the round button to see GridAI

entries.title: Menu counts follow the real data
entries.need: Menu numbers for tickets, AI calls, coupons and abandoned carts were fixed and soon wrong.
entries.now: Those numbers count open tickets, AI calls needing a person, running coupons and open carts, and change as the data does. The AI calls page lists the orders' real automatic calls, so its Needs a person view matches the number.
entries.where: Inbox › Support tickets, Inbox › AI calls, Marketing › Abandoned carts
try: Note the Support tickets number
Solve a ticket and see the number drop
Check Abandoned carts shows the open carts
Open Inbox › AI calls: the calls are the orders' automatic confirmation calls
